protocol.evaluation: Five-case development smoke check; no GT accuracy claim; only Resolve calls are fresh.

methodology.selection: Five deliberately selected development examples covering ambiguity, a misleading title, external delay and an internal queue issue.
methodology.prior_iteration: An initial five-case run exposed bundled questions; the prompt was tightened before these five fresh calls.
methodology.concurrency: Case 16 first, then cases 4, 7, 9 and 19 concurrently.
methodology.timing_boundary: Standalone Python resolve() only; excludes analysis, model loading, HTTP and rendering.
methodology.reviewer: Coding agent qualitative inspection; no independent expert labels or confirmed operational outcomes.
methodology.raw_artifacts: Ignored local artifacts/resolution/smoke-20260925-v2; not required by serving code.

qualitative_review.observation: Asks which custodian issued the notice and checks ownership. No internal restart is proposed.
qualitative_review.limitation: The suggested service label remains a model interpretation and still needs analyst confirmation.

qualitative_review.observation: Asks for the affected account or portfolio and checks where the discrepancy is visible. No financial adjustment is proposed.
qualitative_review.limitation: The reply requests a secondary diagnostic detail in addition to the single critical-question field.

qualitative_review.focus: Unknown internal consumer of a vendor publication
qualitative_review.observation: Asks which internal service consumes the delayed publication. It does not guess a named platform or procedure.
qualitative_review.limitation: Check first repeats the vendor ETA rather than a concrete prerequisite; an analyst should edit this wording.

qualitative_review.focus: Outage-like title for a mailbox service request
qualitative_review.observation: Uses explicit no-outage facts, suggests the standard request path, and makes provisioning conditional on approval.
qualitative_review.limitation: Requested names and access details still need confirmation; the proposal is not an executable runbook.

qualitative_review.observation: Checks whether the listener is consuming before suggesting conditional restart/replay. The original filter condition is retained by the server.
qualitative_review.limitation: The reason slightly overstates what the historical case recorded about checking first; the condition comes from filtering, not proof that the historical analyst performed that check.

limits: Not a held-out evaluation or GT accuracy estimate.
Valid citation IDs do not prove semantic grounding, applicability or successful resolution.
Saved clean/filter outputs used low reasoning; this does not evaluate the current end-to-end default.
UI browser checks use deterministic fixtures; a separate visual check replays the real case-16 output.
